title: mall world theory
content: started with the thought of ‘energy cannot be destroyed nor created’ and pondering life after death. i remembered a fact from when i watched a DMT docu, how your body releases DMT while dying. when people take DMT (the drug) they see other dimensions and entities. something i find interesting about this is that most, if not all, people see the same things, even with no previous experiences or ideas of this phenomenon. that has to be connected, right? some people believe it sends your consciousness to a different astral plane. back to the dying thing,, maybe your body releasing DMT while passing away is to send your consciousness, your energy, to this other astral plane, since energy cannot be destroyed. before i link this to mall world, another thing about your body releasing DMT is that you can learn to make it happen without having to die. people practice meditation and breathing techniques and their bodies will release the DMT. you can learn to do this in a way that your body will do it while your sleeping and leads to ‘profound and vivid dreams’. okay. mall world. i noticed i get mall world dreams more when i have a blocked nose, and in turn snore. with this knowledge on DMT, must be because of the way im breathing, right? a few months ago i got into the habit of mimicking the way i snore before falling asleep, and when i do that i usually have mall world (or at least very vivid, often premonition dreams). i didnt really link it together until now somehow, just knew it usually gave me this result. ive also seen many people on here say they meditate before sleeping for mall world dreams. well what im getting at is, if DMT is released when we die and when we breath a certain way, and if using DMT makes you go to astral planes, and if energy cannot be destroyed so we potentially go to said astral world after death: maybe mall world is a look into this astral realm we go to after death. maybe its a form of ‘hell’ (using this word for lack of a better one). a big place like a maze with strange people, you cannot ever seem to escape, people chasing you, when you are outside theres often tsunamis ect. idk if i explained it well but would love to hear what you think..
